name: LIQUID CONNECT
author: lqd

sections.description:
A WordPress plugin that lets you change site settings — theme colors, social links, and more — and generate block patterns such as pricing tables, simply by chatting with an AI assistant.
It also displays banners / modals with targeting conditions like visitor type, device, and date range to boost your site’s engagement.
It also includes a rule-based chatbot (FAQ responses and post search) that logs visitor questions, so you can analyze customer insights — frequent topics and unanswered questions — with the AI assistant.

AI Assistant

  • Generate and register block patterns (e.g. pricing tables) with live preview
  • Answer questions about theme settings based on the theme’s design document
  • Show A/B test click counts and update banner settings via chat
  • Analyze customer insights from the chatbot log (frequent topics, unanswered questions)
  • Works with connected AI provider (API usage fees apply)

Chatbot

  • Rule-based chatbot — no AI or API configuration required
  • FAQ responses (keyword matching) and post / page search
  • Fallback message with an optional contact link
  • Question log with insight analysis via the AI Assistant
  • Launcher button position (9 positions) and per-page display conditions

A/B Test

Contents
* Images, Button, Link
* Button Color
* Custom HTML, Shortcode
* A/B Test

Target
* New Visitor, Returning Visitor
* Campaign Source (Regex)
* Desktop, Mobile

Trigger
* Page Slug (Regex)
* Scroll Position
* Period
* Banner, Modal (left, center, right)

Other features

  • View & Click Report (Google Analytics Event: gtag.js)
  • LIQUID CONNECT Pro unlocks even more advanced features.
  • You can also check the latest information on LIQUID PRESS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘liquid-connect’ to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Configure ‘AI Assistant β’, ‘A/B Test’ and ‘Chatbot’ in the ‘AI Assistant β’ admin menu
